course.$description: A course is the same colour on every surface. Core picks the palette entry (display_color); shells only render it.

tint.$description: Share of the course colour mixed into the surface.

fill.$description: Something that occupies time: a timetable block, a quiz included (its tag is outlined)

soft.$description: Emphasis on a row: the current or next class

exam.$description: An exam block: a deeper fill than a class, never ringed (a ring means the class in progress); its solid tag sits before the title

ink.$description: Text on a fill: the course colour mixed into ink, on every platform

on-solid.$description: Text on the solid course colour (an exam tag); the palette is mid-tone in both themes
